title: Unique Umami Saudi Arabian Chicken Kebabs
description: Rich and bouncy post-workout Saudi Arabian dish featuring Thai green curry paste and bhuna, cooked to perfection on a binchotan grill, this shojin-friendly meal is perfect for a quick and nutritious dinner
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together Thai green curry paste, bhuna spice mix, coconut milk, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry mixture
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking
Grill the chicken kebabs for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro
